offering_description.value: Airbnb connects travelers with hosts offering short-term and extended stays. It also lets travelers and locals book activities and personal services from independent providers through its website and mobile app.

primary_services.value: short-term stay booking; extended stay booking; activity booking; personal service booking

customer_segment.value: B2C: Travelers, local customers, and individual hosts; B2B: Professional property managers, hospitality operators, and independent activity and service businesses

end_markets.value: vacation rentals and lodging; travel and tourism activities; personal services

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Booking fees on stays, activities, and personal services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Lists stays, activities, and services from independent providers and handles reservations and payments for guests

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Short-term and extended stays, bookable activities, and personal services

distribution_channels.value: online: Airbnb website and mobile app

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local short-term rental registration and zoning rules, lodging taxes, consumer protection, and data privacy requirements
